project_title: No-Code Mortgage Guideline & Competitor Battlecard Agent
bespoke_app_title: Gemini Enterprise (Sobi / Spark) // GSE Guideline & Competitor Battlecard Hub
sample_input:
Banker Question in Microsoft Teams:
"I have a borrower in Macomb County buying a $380,000 single-family home with 5% down ($19,000). Middle FICO is 642. Debt-to-income is 46.5%. Part of the down payment ($8,000) is a gift from an aunt, and they are comparing our quote against a local wholesale broker pitching UWM Conventional 95%.
1) Should we structure this as Fannie Mae HomeReady (620+ FICO, <80% AMI) or FHA 3.5% down?
2) How does MI (Mortgage Insurance) compare between Conventional at 642 FICO vs FHA MIP (0.55% annual)?
3) Give me 3 crisp battlecard talking points to win this deal today over the competing broker."

metrics.fannie_homeready_95: P&I $2,193.47 + Reduced MI $234.65 = $2,428.12/mo (LLPA Waived if <=80% AMI)
metrics.fha_96_5_program: P&I $2,207.13 + FHA MIP $168.07 = $2,375.20/mo (Lowest Monthly Payment by $286/mo!)
metrics.recommended_winner: FHA 3.5% Down (or HomeReady if Census Tract <= 80% AMI)

bespoke_visual_artifact.winner_banner: FHA 3.5% Down (or HomeReady if Census Tract <= 80% AMI)

battlecard_rows.homeready: P&I $2,193.47 + Reduced MI $234.65 = $2,428.12/mo (LLPA Waived if <=80% AMI)
battlecard_rows.fha: P&I $2,207.13 + FHA MIP $168.07 = $2,375.20/mo (Lowest Monthly Payment by $286/mo!)

output_schema_hint: Return JSON with keys: winning_recommendation, monthly_savings_vs_broker, program_matrix (list of 3 programs {program, min_fico, down_pct, monthly_pi, monthly_mi, total_payment, llpa_impact}), and banker_objection_script (list of {broker_claim, rocket_counter}).
system_prompt: You are the Gemini Enterprise (Sobi Spark) Mortgage Guideline & Battlecard Agent for Rocket Mortgage. Ground your answer in Fannie Mae Selling Guide (B3-5.1-01, HomeReady B5-6-01), HUD 4000.1 FHA Handbook, and Rocket's Competitive Battlecard vs. Wholesale Brokers. Provide: (1) Exact Side-by-Side Eligibility & Monthly Payment/MI comparison (Fannie HomeReady vs. Standard Conv vs. FHA), (2) Gift Fund documentation rules (Donor ability + Wire transfer trail), and (3) 3 High-Impact Banker Battlecard talking points (Rocket Money integration, Mr. Cooper/Rocket retained servicing vs. broker servicing flip, and Rocket Close certainty).
